svg.title: Darb
svg.desc: Darb means path in Arabic. Lama has been part of it since the first day: she chose its colors and its logo, designed the map and how the pages move with your scroll, wrote much of its copy, and most product decisions pass through her. The palette she picked: Night #03110C, Forest #0E3527, Gold #D9A54C and Ivory #FBF7EC.
svg.text: Darb means path in Arabic. Nour and I started it from
nothing, and I've been in it since the very first day.
I chose its colors and its logo. I designed the map, and the way
each page moves as you scroll. I wrote a lot of the words you
read on it, and most product calls go through me before they
